name: Aquabeek
protoformUtility: Shoots clean squirts of fresh water for drinking or washing away small debris.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a water-dwelling beast that fires high-pressure hydro-cannon streams capable of blasting away heavy objects and extinguishing fires.

name: Arachnet
protoformUtility: Spins strong silk strands useful for grappling lines, securing cargo, or tying knots.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a giant, multi-eyed spider creature that fires sticky webbing nets, constructs web trampolines, and traps targets.

name: Armashelt
protoformUtility: Deflects minor incoming projectiles off its tough outer shell or acts as a doorstop.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a massive boulder-like organism with impenetrable armor plates, curling into a rolling wrecking ball to demolish fortifications.

name: Blastipede
protoformUtility: Leaves small, benign glowing dots that can mark paths or serve as signal markers.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a centipede-like creature that drops explosive landmine nodes across the field, which detonate upon contact or at the slugslinger's command.

name: Boon Doc
protoformUtility: Emits a soothing light that heals minor cuts and relieves fatigue.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a radiant energy creature that emits pure light waves capable of curing Ghoul Slugs, restoring severe injuries, and purifying dark energy.

name: Bubbaleone
protoformUtility: Blows durable, buoyant bubbles that act as soft cushions, floating rafts, or makeshift storage containers.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a giant inflated organism that launches massive soapy spheres, trapping enemies inside suffocating bubbles or expanding to absorb heavy kinetic impacts.

name: Crystalyd
protoformUtility: Focuses ambient light into sharp crystalline beams to mark stone walls.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a drill-headed crystalline beast capable of tunneling through solid rock at high speeds and creating vast subterranean networks.

name: Diggrix
protoformUtility: Scoops away soft dirt quickly to create small trenches or shelters.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a giant mole-like creature that digs massive trenches, creates tremors, and hurls large boulders at opponents.

name: Dirt Urchin
protoformUtility: Shoots tiny, soft quills that stick to surfaces, useful for marking trails or setting minor traps.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a spiky urchin-like monster that fires barrages of razor-sharp quills, creating hazards on the battlefield and pinning targets to walls.

name: Enigmo
protoformUtility: Produces a soft aura and aids in locating hidden paths or ancient slug lore.
velocityAbility: When fired with another slug significantly boosts their power. Can draw slugs to where it was shot. It can prevent opponent slugs from transforming.

name: Fandango
protoformUtility: Has an aura of energy that allows other slugs to recover quicker and last longer in duels before misfiring
velocityAbility: Morphs into a glowing chronomancer that rattles whoever it hits -- for the next 3 of their own turns, that target's own shots have a real chance of firing a complete 180 off target, not just a small miss.

name: Firenzar
protoformUtility: Leaves glowing trail marks that stay hot for several minutes to track back through cold caverns.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a blazing reptilian speedster that streaks across the battlefield, leaving walls of fire behind and scorching targets with high-velocity drive-by strikes.

name: Flaringo
protoformUtility: Emits a bright, glowing flame from its head that can illuminate dark caverns, ignite campfires or fuses, and thaw frozen locks without expending energy pips.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a blazing firebird that streaks straight at a single target, dealing fire damage on impact and leaving a wall of flame burning along the entire path it flew.

name: Flatulorhinkus
protoformUtility: Releases tiny, harmless puffs of foul-smelling gas to deter small creatures or clear personal space.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a bloated, gas-emitting creature that sprays dense, noxious clouds of paralyzing or blinding stink-gas across a wide radius.

name: Flopper
protoformUtility: Squirts a harmless drop of water or flops around uselessly, offering mild moral support or serving as a distraction.
velocityAbility: Fails to transform at velocity, flying through the air as a squishy slug before bouncing harmlessly off targets with a wet slapping sound.

name: Forgesmelter
protoformUtility: Generates extreme localized heat capable of welding broken metal or rapidly heating tools.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a colossal molten-iron beast that spews streams of liquid magma, melts enemy equipment, and creates pools of burning slag.

name: Frightgeist
protoformUtility: Distorts nearby light and shadows to spook wild animals or send eerie signals.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a phantom-like terror that passes through solid objects, projecting terrifying spectral illusions -- whoever it hits spends their entire next turn fleeing, sprinting up to 3 AP worth of movement straight away from where the shot came from.

name: Frostcrawler
protoformUtility: Instantly cools water, freezes small puddles into footholds, or chills rations.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a spiky ice beast that fires razor-sharp icicles, flash-freezes targets in thick glaciers, and constructs giant ice walls.

name: Gazzer
protoformUtility: Emits tiny puffs of gas that cause mild giggling or lightheadedness.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a floating gaseous entity that sprays dense hysterical-laughing gas across the battlefield, leaving opponents completely unable to fight.

name: Geoshard
protoformUtility: Creates small decorative quartz-like crystals on surfaces to reflect light.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a heavily armored crystal entity that shoots razor-sharp glass projectiles and constructs reflective crystal shields that bounce beam attacks back at attackers.

name: Grenuke
protoformUtility: Generates low-frequency ticking vibrations to signal danger or test structural stability.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a massive bio-nuclear ordnance beast that triggers a massive, high-impact explosion upon contact, obliterating obstacles and heavy armor.

name: Hexlet
protoformUtility: Causes minor unlucky glitches in nearby electronics, like flickering lights or faulty sensors.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a shadowy, hexing entity that fires curse bolts that jinx the target's blaster mechanism, whether the shot lands or not -- their next shot misfires.

name: Hop Rock
protoformUtility: Generates small, controlled micro-blasts useful for cracking nuts or starting small rockslides.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a heavy, cluster-bomb creature that bounces wildly across the terrain before detonating into multiple explosive shrapnel fragments.

name: Hoverbug
protoformUtility: Creates light breezes to clear smoke, dust, or cool down companions while hovering in place.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a winged insectoid creature capable of generating gale-force wind gusts, lifting allies across chasms, and deflecting incoming slug shots.

name: Hypnogrif
protoformUtility: Emits low-frequency waves that make nearby creatures feel calm or drowsy.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a winged, hypnotic beast that projects powerful mental waves, hypnotizing opponents, causing confusion, or putting targets into a deep trance.

name: Infurnus
protoformUtility: Produces small controlled flames for lighting torches, warming allies, or welding small metal objects.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a flaming phoenix-like creature that spews high-heat lava streams, creates fiery barriers, and flies at extreme speeds.

name: Jellyish
protoformUtility: Produces small droplets of non-toxic adhesive, perfect for quick makeshift repairs.
velocityAbility: Morphs into an amorphous, jelly-like creature that launches massive globs of sticky slime to immobilize opponents and cushion heavy falls.

name: Lariat
protoformUtility: Extends a sticky tongue to grab small objects from out-of-reach places like a quick grappling hook.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a frog-like creature with an elastic, high-tensile tongue that snatches enemy blasters, yanks opponents toward it, or swings allies across wide gaps.

name: Lavalynx
protoformUtility: Radiates high ambient heat to melt ice or heat metal tools rapidly.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a feline magma beast that spits molten lava rivers, consumes surrounding thermal energy, and leaves pools of burning magma.

name: Makobreaker
protoformUtility: Uses its hardened, razor-sharp head-crest to slice through thin metals or score stone.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a giant armored land-shark that tunnels through rock and earth before lunging with crushing jaws to snap enemy defenses.

name: Mimkey
protoformUtility: Intelligenty mocks enemies
velocityAbility: When transformed does almost no damage, unless it is shot as a counter, it takes the shape of the oposing slug and cancels each other out.

name: Narwhaddle
protoformUtility: Uses its small frozen horn to chip away at ice buildup or poke holes in soft materials.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a horned aquatic beast that rams through obstacles with a massive ice drill-horn, creating freezing shockwaves on impact.

name: Negashade
protoformUtility: Absorbs ambient light around itself, creating small pockets of pitch-black shadow for concealment.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a shadowy draconic phantom that smothers the target in complete darkness -- blinded, their next attack roll suffers disadvantage -- and leaves a lingering pocket of dark terrain behind.

name: Neotox
protoformUtility: Secretes tiny drops of corrosive fluid to dissolve rust or weaken small fasteners.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a reptilian toxic beast that sprays melting acid pools and clouds of paralyzing neurotoxic gas across the target area.

name: Phosphora
protoformUtility: Glows intensely like a high-powered lantern to illuminate dark subterranean caverns.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a blinding light entity that fires high-intensity laser beams and flashbangs targets, causing temporary blindness.

name: Pieper
protoformUtility: Emits high-pitched chirps that can mimic simple sounds or distract small subterranean critters.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a siren-like creature that emits mesmerizing sonic frequencies, controlling the movements of nearby wild slugs and forcing them to follow its command.

name: Polero
protoformUtility: Wraps its split tail around small objects to carry them or hang from overhead beams.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a bola-like creature that splits mid-flight to bind an enemy's limbs with unbreakable energy tethers, snaring them in place for two of their own turns.

name: Rammstone
protoformUtility: Crushes small stones, digs footholds into soft earth, or wedges small openings open.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a heavily armored, quadrupedal ram beast capable of smashing through solid granite walls and creating shockwaves.

name: Sand Angler
protoformUtility: Softens small patches of soil or sand, making digging easier.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a burrowing sand-beast that whips up a blinding sandstorm -- the target's next attack roll suffers disadvantage -- and buries their legs in quicksand, unable to Move for two of their own turns.

name: Slicksilver
protoformUtility: Attracts small metallic items like keys or loose bolts with a low-grade magnetic field.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a metallic entity that generates a massive electromagnetic pulse, pulling or repelling heavy metal objects and frying the target's blaster electronics -- whether the shot lands or not, their next shot misfires.

name: Slyren
protoformUtility: Hums a quiet lullaby that induces mild drowsiness in small creatures.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a winged siren creature that projects powerful, harmonious sound waves, putting entire groups of targets into a deep, uninterrupted sleep -- a full skipped turn for everyone caught in the blast.

name: Speedstinger
protoformUtility: Moves at incredible speeds over short distances to retrieve dropped tools or scout ahead unnoticed.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a sleek, armored runner capable of ricocheting off wall surfaces at blinding speeds to strike from unpredictable angles.

name: Tazerling
protoformUtility: Acts as a portable battery to jumpstart machinery, charge power packs, or produce mild static sparks.
velocityAbility: Morphs into an electrified reptilian creature that discharges chain lightning to a nearby second target and delivers a paralyzing shock on a hit, skipping the target's next turn entirely.

name: Thresher
protoformUtility: Cuts through thin ropes or vines using its sharp head-fin.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a razor-toothed, shark-like organism with spinning blade appendages that slices through metal obstacles, armor, and stone like paper.

name: Thugglet
protoformUtility: Uses faint telekinesis to nudge small objects or tug on loose gear to annoy opponents.
velocityAbility: Transforms into an impish phantom that projects illusory duplicates of itself, jinxing an enemy's blaster so their next shot misfires. Shot at yourself instead, it turns you invisible for 1 turn -- hidden from every other player until you're hit or the turn ends.

name: Tormato
protoformUtility: Produces small, gentle whirlwinds that clear dust, blow away light debris, or fan flames.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a roaring air elemental that creates a violent tornado, lifting targets into the air and scattering incoming projectiles.

name: Vinedrill
protoformUtility: Sprouts fast-growing vines to weave temporary ropes, secure gear, or harvest hard-to-reach flora.
velocityAbility: Morphs into a massive botanical monster that burrows root systems, entangles enemies in thorned tendrils, and unleashes paralyzing spore clouds.

name: Xmitter
protoformUtility: Emits minor static pulses that clear radio static or briefly disrupt digital displays.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a high-voltage entity that discharges a powerful electromagnetic shockwave, instantly short-circuiting the target's blaster -- whether the shot lands or not, their next shot misfires.

name: Emberblade
protoformUtility: When cooking from a fire made by this slug, the food quality is increased.
velocityAbility: Transforms into a fire-sword wielding slug that cuts at it's enemies. When this slug is involved in a clash, it's power and defense are trippled and a fire wall is formed along its trajectory.

name: Frostfire
protoformUtility: The slug can freeze and defreeze objects in a cryo stasis.
velocityAbility: When shooting this slug you can either deal fire damage to the target, or build an Ice wall or Ice bridge.

name: Sagebloom
protoformUtility: This slug grows seeds on its head and hands that make for tasteful spices.
velocityAbility: When this slug transforms its hands shoot seeds dealing high damage to the target.

name: Zeus
protoformUtility: This slug can super charge equipment making htem function at 200% for an hour, but afterwards breaks the technology
velocityAbility: This slug travels with lightning fast speed, making it near impossible to counter -- its own flight is a blur too.

name: Bladier
protoformUtility: Shifts and hardens it's body to form a strong dagger that can be thrown or used in Melee
velocityAbility: Transforms to a dagger wielding projectile. On a normal attack it punches straight through the first wall in its path -- breaking it open -- and keeps flying through for a direct, full-power hit on the intended target.

name: Cybercut
protoformUtility: This slug can connect to electronics and hack them.
velocityAbility: When transformed forms two electric swords that arc lightning to the closest target.
